title: Einstein's deathbed breakthrough

tellings.quote: there's a saying that on his deathbed he suddenly became ecstatic and was started talking excitedly to his nurse in German.

plain: The story goes that Albert Einstein, on his deathbed in Princeton in 1955, suddenly became ecstatic and began talking excitedly to his nurse in German, as if he had finally cracked something. John Brandenburg, a guest who argues that life on Mars was wiped out by nuclear war, tells Michels this as "a saying" he has heard, not something he saw. If it were true, it would mean Einstein reached a last breakthrough that died with him.
